sloka: तीक्ष्णः प्रकृत्या सुग्रीवः प्रिया रक्तः च राघवः ।समीक्ष्य अकृत कार्यान् तु तस्मिन् च समये गते ॥४-५३-२१॥
transliteration: tīkṣṇaḥ prakṛtyā sugrīvaḥ priyā raktaḥ ca rāghavaḥ ।samīkṣya akṛta kāryān tu tasmin ca samaye gate ॥4-53-21॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys don't you realize that all of us have come here at the command of the monkey king, and while we were in the cave a whole month has gone by?
